title: Can LLM Generate Culturally Relevant Commonsense QA Data? Case Study in Indonesian and Sundanese

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM zero-shot accuracy on culturally localized commonsense QA datasets (Indonesian and Sundanese), and assessing the relevance of LLM-generated concepts versus default Western-centric concepts (e.g., winter sports, US-centric locations) using human evaluation and a concept relevancy classifier.

Comparing generation quality, sentence fluency, translation accuracy, and multiple-choice QA performance between a medium-resource language (Indonesian) and a lower-resource regional language (Sundanese).
